components.name: TutorialFloat
components.description: A small floating card that says what to do next in a hands-on tutorial. It follows its anchor every frame: beside it when there's room, otherwise over the top of what it covers, always inside its boundary, and slid aside from the point it should not hide. Pair it with Tutorial Actions to point at the thing to press or drag.

props.name: side
props.description: auto sits beside the anchor when there's room on either side, otherwise over the top of `cover`. The others always use that side; over sits inside the top of `cover`.

props.name: cover
props.description: What the card covers when it sits over. Default the anchor.

props.name: boundary
props.description: Keeps the card inside this element instead of the window.

props.name: avoid
props.description: A point the card slides aside to keep clear, e.g. what Tutorial Actions presses.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Small line above the title. Default "Try it · 2 of 5" when `step` and `steps` are set.

props.name: steps
props.description: How many steps, one dot each.

props.name: done
props.description: The last card: every dot fills, Skip gives way to the done button, and it fades out and calls `onDone` after `autoClose` ms.

props.name: autoClose
props.description: How long the done card stays, in ms. false keeps it until the button.

props.name: float
props.description: A slow bob while it waits.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in px. Beside the anchor it narrows to fit, down to `minWidth`.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: The narrowest the card gets beside the anchor before auto moves it over.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between the card and the anchor, in px.
